description: List every LIVE comparison segment on nakus.sk with its unit metric (€/kg, €/kus, €/pranie, €/ml, €/m…). Use FIRST when the user asks what categories NaKus covers, which metric a category uses, or before searching if you are unsure whether a product type is in scope. Does NOT return prices or Cite slugs — next call search_cite_answers, then get_unit_price. Optional group filter: milacikovia | rodina | domacnost | sport-kava | kancelaria. Brand is nakus.sk (NaKus), NOT nakup.sk. Read-only, idempotent.

group.description: Optional nav group. Omit for all live segments. milacikovia=pet · rodina=baby/family · domacnost=laundry/home · sport-kava=protein/coffee · kancelaria=paper/toner
